text:
deploy-bot: Starting rollout: model-release/2026-03-17 v2.14 -> canary (10%)
runtime_sam: Canary pods are returning odd tokenized outputs in prod-canary (gpt-family). Samples show extra alias tokens and split words.
anna_eng: can you paste a sample?
runtime_sam: sample from canary-3: 'How to reset password? -> How to Ġreset Ġpassword ?' and embeddings for identical inputs diverge ~0.25 cosine.
sre_oncall_mike: paged — this looks like tokenizer or vocab alias mismatch, could be a new tokenizer mapping in the artifact. Routing traces show canary nodes got artifact: model-v2.14+alias-map-20260317.
alice_prod: Customer-facing: no high-severity reports yet but a few support tickets with garbled replies. Support triage says ~12 customers affected, low-volume.
support_jess: Confirmed tickets with garbled assistants in beta accounts. Adding 'impact: partial textual corruption, non-blocking' to the ticket.
runtime_sam: Uploading failing sample and diff: `diff v2.13->v2.14: alias_map.json changed; param_hash for tokenizer 0x7f3 vs expected 0x4c2`
anna_eng: If alias_map changed unexpectedly, kill switch for alias-routing flag exists: ff.alias_routing=true. Recommend flipping to false to stop new mapping.
sre_oncall_mike: Flipping feature flag now: `./ops/flags/flip ff.alias_routing false --env=prod` — done. Observability: canary error rate down from 18%->2% over 40s.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-20260317-13 - model tokenizer alias drift during canary rollout. Pager escalations suppressed (low customer severity).
alice_prod: Good — please prepare rollback to v2.13 for canary if errors persist. Notify CS.
customer-success-liz: Notifying affected accounts with mitigation notice: we'll revert canary and follow-up with timeline.
anna_eng: Rolling back canary artifact to v2.13 now: `deployctl promote model-release/2026-02-28-v2.13 --to=canary`
runtime_sam: promote command issued, pods draining and redeploying. Monitoring token samples.
sre_oncall_mike: oncall handoff to @sre_oncall_mike + @anna_eng for next 2 hours while we watch for regression.
support_jess: CS note: created template message for customers.
runtime_sam: After rollback, sample outputs match previous baseline; cosine diffs back to <0.01. No further garbling observed.
alice_prod: Flag flip + canary rollback resolved customer-facing symptoms. Keep incident open for postmortem and root-cause: why alias_map changed in artifact build.
anna_eng: Filing jira: AIINF-9876 - unexpected alias_map bake in model artifact pipeline. Assigning to runtime infra and build infra.
incident-bot: Updating INC-20260317-13 status -> monitoring.
sre_oncall_mike: Note for postmortem: tighten pre-deploy artifact checks: verify tokenizer param_hash and alias_map compatibility against baseline.
customer-success-liz: Logged affected accounts, offered dedicated follow-up, no credits required at this time.
alice_prod: Thanks team, will schedule hotfix to reject builds that change alias_map unless explicitly approved.
runtime_sam: leaving additional logs and sample diffs in the incident thread (links pasted in ticket).
anna_eng: I'll own the postmortem. Closing active mitigation; keep INC open until RCA complete. :thumbsup:
